def workflow(topics_topicarn_0: str, topics_topicarn_1: str):
    # Retrieve the topic information using the provided helper function
    sns\_topic\_info = Amazon\_SNS\_Topic\_\_3\_0\_0\_\_retrievewithwhere\_Topic(topics\_topicarn\_0, topics\_topicarn\_1)

    # Extract the relevant information from the SNS topic
    subject = sns\_topic\_info['topics\_subject']
    description = sns\_topic\_info['topics\_description']

    # Create a new Zendesk service ticket using the provided helper function
    zendesk\_ticket = Zendesk\_Service\_Ticket\_\_2\_0\_0\_\_create\_Ticket(
        subject=subject,
        description=description,
        priority='normal',
        source='API',
        tags=['sns']
    )

    # Send an email notification using the provided helper function
    Microsoft\_Exchange\_Messages\_\_2\_0\_0\_\_SENDOUTLOOK\_Messages(
        recipient\_emails=['support@example.com'],
        subject=f"New Zendesk Ticket from SNS: {subject}",
        body=f"A new Zendesk ticket has been created from an SNS topic.\n\nSubject: {subject}\nDescription: {description}"
    )

    # Return the created Zendesk ticket
    return zendesk\_ticket
